name: fix-hoh1-off
about: Game night 10.28.26 (a lobby hung on 'wait_loaded_level': the host loaded hoh1/levels/battlements_1.lvl, which the friends' packs lack): with the HoH1 import packed and hoh1.content off (its default), no floor loads an HoH1 file. In town the campaign, pets and trinkets log their stand-ins, `hwp hoh1` says off and the portal offers the HoH2 tower; the Pet Shop lists no HoH1 pet, and toggling the flag live lists them, puts a bought one away and brings it back, and swaps the campaign floors at once; the Dark Citadel's hwp_battlements_1 and _2 load generated floors and `cht_finish_level` reaches the Avatar; the HoH1 tower's first and last floors load HoH2 files. No StartLoadServer hoh1/ anywhere. About 6 minutes.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:campaign\] self-check done: mission ok, \d+/\d+ schemes, HoH1 floors installed, off \(hoh1\.content\),
steps.name: campaign self-check: the import is packed, the flag is off

steps.pattern: \[HWP:campaign\] hoh1\.content off: hwp_forsaken_tower_hoh1: (\d+)/\1 floors on HoH2 stand-ins
steps.name: every HoH1 tower floor has an HoH2 stand-in

steps.pattern: \[HWP:campaign\] hoh1\.content off: Dark Citadel hwp_battlements_1, hwp_battlements_2 are generated Dark Halls floors
steps.name: the Dark Citadel's Battlements floors are generated

steps.pattern: \[HWP:pets\] hoh1\.content off: [1-9]\d* HoH1 pet\(s\) out of the Pet Shop
steps.name: the HoH1 pets are out of the shop
the trinkets keep their placeholder icons

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] HoH1 content is off \(Plus menu: HoH1 content\), so these use stand-ins:
steps.name: the chat says it is off and how to turn it on, not that it is missing
no mission floor left on an HoH1 file
town: off reported, HoH2 portal; Pet Shop: none listed off, the pet put away and back live
Dark Citadel: hwp_battlements_1 and _2 generated, cht_finish_level reaches the boss
HoH1 tower floors 0 and 22 load HoH2 files
no level loaded from hoh1/ during the run
